name: Grok Skills
desc: Instructions you teach Grok once, applied in every later conversation.
desc_zh: 教给 Grok 一次的可复用指令，之后每次对话都会自动生效。
solves: You retype the same formatting rules and workflow steps every session; a skill stores them and your own version overrides the built-in one.
solves_zh: 每段会话都要重打同样的格式规范和工作步骤；skill 把它们存下来，你的版本还会覆盖内置版本。
best_for: You keep telling Grok how you want reports structured and want it to just remember this time.
best_for_zh: 反复交代报告该怎么组织，想让 Grok 这次真的记住时。
